title: GSODDB/SuSnowDB Schema
text: location_code:location code ,alphanumeric; location_code0:location code (PRIMARY KEY),alphanumeric,unique; location_name :location human readable (geographic) name altitude: altitude meters sea level; city_name: name city related location (exsists); country_code_iso_3166_1: ISO 3166-1 administrative area code (e.g country code)(see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1); country_code_iso_3166_2: ISO 3166-2 administrative area code (e.g. region/province/state code) (see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-2); country_name Country Human Readable Name; description Description location/siter; geometry Geospatial coordinates (case point), managed geospatial ttols (e.g. sf postGIS); location_source Source data location; location_url Reference URL location; use_limitations Terms Use location data metadata.

title: GSODDB/SuSnowDB Schema
text: variable_code0: variable code (PRIMARY KEY),alphanumeric,unique; variable: human readable name variable; unit: measurement unit; description: textual description measurement type; measurement_time_interval: time interval variable measured /reported, e.g. hourly, daily, monthly, etc.. .

title: GSODDB/SuSnowDB Schema
text: time:timestamp-TZ instant ; value: numeric value measurement (expressed unit variable_code0) ; flag: flag related measurent (see description); location_code0: location code (FOREIGN KEY table locations) location measurement; variable_code0: variable code (FOREIGN KEY thable _measurement_types) measured variable; description: textual description notes measurement.
